## Checklist

- [ ] The folder is `plugins/<id>/` and `id` in `plugin.json` is the same
- [ ] `version` is raised (if this changes a plugin that is already listed)
- [ ] The folder has a README, and either the plugin is fine under the repository's MIT licence or the folder has its own `LICENSE.txt`
- [ ] I ran `python build.py` and committed `packages/` and `index.json`
